notes.expr: the face drawn in the references: shut = eyes closed, o = mouth open, line = mouth pressed shut
notes.view: the direction the pose is shown in: front (facing the viewer) for all but bent_over, which is shown from behind (up_right = 3/4 from behind reads best; back also works)
notes.binds: each frame lists its restraints: joint + joint2 = a band between two joints; joint -> anchor = a restraint pulling that joint toward a point

extra_joints.face: 9px ahead of the head centre: where she looks
